## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up at `a9db5db`, after the [earlier review at `0692a85`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12970#issuecomment-5787632351) and the [author's update](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12970#issuecomment-5800563021).

No actionable production defect found in the reviewed scope at `a9db5db`. The earlier review's "no actionable defect" conclusion is corrected below; the issue it missed is resolved in this revision.

### Correction: stale deferred submenu callbacks at `0692a85` (resolved)

The earlier Verified note was accurate: both stack writes were deferred with `Qt.callLater`, and leaving updated the stack before destroying the removed opener. Its no-defect conclusion was overstated. At `0692a85` each queued callback applied a stack captured at click time without checking that the same menu was still open. If the popup closed, reopened or switched tray items before the queued callback ran, the old callback could publish a stale submenu or leave an opener undestroyed. The [author's comment](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12970#issuecomment-5789671106) identified the same gap.

```text
Headless QML harness, stub Quickshell modules; App2 opened before the queued tick

click "A" in App1's menu  ->  enter callback queued
App2 tray click           ->  openTrayMenu() -> resetTrayMenu()
queued callback runs:
  0692a85: App2's popup shows App1's "A" submenu (rows A1, A2); extra opener stays alive
  a9db5db: generation changed -> opener destroyed; App2's root menu shown
```

**Verified (`a9db5db`):**
- `close()` and `resetTrayMenu()` increment `trayMenuGeneration`. `enterSubmenu()` and `leaveSubmenu()` capture it and check generation and `trayMenuOpen` inside the `Qt.callLater` callback.
- A stale enter destroys its unpublished opener. A stale leave does nothing, and reset tears down the published openers.
- Current-generation transitions keep the deferred writes, and leaving still updates the stack before destroying the removed opener.
- Normal enter, leave, leaf click, close and reopen flows match the base revision in the harness.

**Optional test improvement:** The new `tray-test.sh` block checks the helper's truth table and that certain strings exist. It no longer rejects a synchronous `submenuStack = stack` or `top.opener.destroy()` before `Qt.callLater`, which the `0692a85` test did. Reinserting the synchronous `submenuStack = stack` in `enterSubmenu` (the pattern from #12938) still passes the new test. Restoring those two negative assertions would keep that protection. The added assertions call the pure helper; they do not close or reopen a menu before a queued callback.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection of `a9db5db`, `0692a85` and base, including Qt 6.11.2 and Quickshell 0.3.1 sources for `Qt.callLater`, Repeater regeneration and menu openers. `tray-test.sh` ran in an isolated sandbox using Deno's Node compatibility in place of Node (all assertions pass at `a9db5db`), with source mutations. A headless Qt 6.11.2 QML harness loaded the real `Tray.qml` and `TrayModel.js` with stub Quickshell modules and simulated a close or reopen before the queued callback. The reported SIGSEGV fix was not reproduced in live Quickshell.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh follow-up technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
